title: UK Announces Ban on Goods From Israeli Settlements
description:
Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, speaking in the House of Commons, said the UK will ban the import of goods from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied territories through a new sanctions regime. “The British government agrees that there is ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in areas of the West Bank,” Miliband told lawmakers.
